name: White Bog Orchid
desc: White Bog Orchid (Platanthera dilatata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 10 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Platanthera dilatata, known as tall white bog orchid, bog candle, or boreal bog orchid is a species of orchid, a flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae, native to North America.
